description: This file is a shell script that defines a test for git submodule revert functionality. It sets up the test description, sources utility scripts, defines a function to test reverting in git involving submodules, and runs the test.

methods.name: git_revert
methods.description: A shell function that performs a series of git commands to test reverting to a previous commit involving submodules, including status checks, tarball creation/restoration, and comparison of work trees.
